item.title: ASHES CRADLE
item.description: Ashes Cradle is my ongoing personal project exploring level desgin and visual world building. It is an immersive 2D puzzle-platformer that takes place in an alien world where time has stopped. The player acts as a young thief who was born after the time freeze. While attempting to steal valuable yet unknown government equipment, the heist goes awry, and soldiers are now in hot pursuit. While escaping from the armed forces, they gradually unravel the mysteries behind the stolen equipment, explore the enigmatic continent, and uncover the truth behind the frozen world.
